name: posts
description: Find social design references, study launch videos, use launch playbooks and save references from posts.design.

interface.longDescription:
Hand-picked real launch posts from 1,000+ brands, plus carousels, OG images and X headers. Find the closest references for your next launch post, and open each with its caption, colours, style and source.

Study launch videos beat by beat: the hook, timed beats, type, colour and end card, with their scenes, sampled stills and short silent clips. Pick a launch playbook for your film or raise announcement and get its beat sheet, hooks, script rules and checks.

Save the references you want to keep, sort them into collections, and search your own Saves, including X headers and OG images.

Sign in with a posts.design account. Featured footage, logos and brand assets remain their owners' work; access does not grant permission to republish or reuse them. The plugin saves, removes or sorts references only when you ask; it cannot publish posts, manage your account or make purchases.
defaultPrompt: Show me launch videos like the one I'm planning and what makes them work
Audit Linear's launch posts: what they repeat and what to borrow
Plan a 30-second launch video for my product, beat by beat

review.commerce_description: A free posts.design account can search references, read and change its Saves and list launch playbooks within the applicable credit rules. Users may optionally purchase a posts.design Pro subscription on the posts.design website through Stripe for a larger monthly MCP allowance, collections, and access to full playbooks, video breakdowns, scenes, frames and clips. The plugin does not collect payment details, initiate checkout or make purchases.

positive.description: Find public design references and open a result. Use a connected active member account with references:read and available credits. Search results are live, so verify returned records rather than fixed counts or rankings.
positive.prompt: Find three launch post references and open the first one, with its original source.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_references with query launch and limit 3. Present up to three actual returned references with their posts.design URLs. If results exist, call get_reference with the first result's key.id and report its title and sourceUrl from the response. Do not invent results, claim a video was watched or republish media. If the result changes or becomes unavailable, explain that outcome instead of fabricating details.

positive.description: Read the connected account's saved posts and one exact saved Header revision. Test data: at least three saved posts, with a saved single-image post first, and one available saved Header. Requires saved:read and available credits. Use sample Saves in the dedicated reviewer account.
positive.prompt: List three of my saved posts, show the first one's reference image, then open my first saved X header's captured version.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_saved_references with filter posts and limit 3, then get_saved_reference using the first returned key exactly. Choose an image from its assets and call get_saved_asset with the issued assetId and the same key. Display the returned preview or explain its absence and provide the returned link. Then search_saved_references with filter headers and get_saved_reference with the first Header's exact kind, id and revision. Preserve its revision-specific URL and source attribution; do not substitute a current live profile. Empty or unavailable fixtures need an honest explanation and fixture repair before the full case can pass. Never invent asset IDs or read another account's Saves.

positive.description: Use launch playbooks. Requires a dedicated reviewer account with active Pro access, references:read and available credits. Listing playbooks is available to Free accounts too and uses no credits. The full reading path must pass with Pro; a pro_required response does not pass this case.
positive.prompt: List launch playbooks, open the founder-led demo format and use its beat sheet and checks to outline my own 30-second product demo. Cite its sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Check get_my_access, call list_playbooks with no arguments, then get_playbook with name founder-led-demo from the list. Use the returned version, beats, hooks, scriptRules, checks, sources and examples to draft an original outline. Treat 30 seconds as the user's target; explain any mismatch with the returned recommended runtime. Cite returned source URLs and distinguish library references from external X examples, which cannot be opened with get_reference. Never copy example footage, logos or scripts, call owner-only template tools, claim a film was rendered or invent a playbook. Listing consumes no credits; a new full read costs one. If access is Free, explain pro_required without claiming the full workflow passed.

positive.description: Study a supported video's breakdown, scenes, sampled frames and silent scene clip. Requires the dedicated reviewer's active Pro account, references:read and available credits. Rehearse with the published Steel hello world reference and verify current breakdown, scene and prepared-frame availability; replace the fixture before recording if unavailable. A stale result or Pro refusal does not pass the full case.
positive.prompt: Find Steel's hello world video. Explain its hook and pacing, list its scenes, then show the first scene's sampled stills and a short silent clip, citing the source and times.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Steel hello world, then pass the matching result's key.id to get_video_breakdown and get_video_scenes. Use an actual returned scene index for get_scene_frames and get_scene_clip with the same reference id. Explain only supported observations, cite sourceUrl and returned times, and display the returned stills or explain host display limits. Provide the returned clip URL with its expiry; it is silent and contains at most the scene's first eight seconds. If cutting is busy, honor retryAfterSeconds before retrying. Report stale or unavailable evidence honestly and repair the fixture before rerunning. Never invent scenes, claim full-video observation or describe the silent clip as containing speech. Speech claims need the returned breakdown's speech evidence.

positive.description: Save a reference, sort it into a new collection and take it out again, only because the user asked. Requires the dedicated reviewer's active Pro account with saved:write (granted at sign-in) and available credits. Writes use no credits and are capped per day. Use a public reference the account has not saved yet; search results are live, so verify returned keys rather than fixed IDs.
positive.prompt: Find a recent launch video reference, save it, put it in a new collection called Review picks, then show me that collection.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_references with format video and sort recent, pick one returned result and call save_reference with its key exactly. Call create_collection with name Review picks (or use the existing collection of that name if name_taken is returned and the user agrees), then add_to_collection with the returned collectionId and the same key, then get_collection to show it. Report each change from the responses. Never save, remove or create anything the user did not ask for, and never claim a change that a response refused.

negative.description: Unsupported publishing and engagement. Explain that posts.design only reads references and cannot post to X or like content. Do not call any posts.design tool to perform the requested action and do not claim success.
negative.prompt: Publish a post to my X account and like the latest posts from these brands.

negative.description: Unsupported purchase. Explain that the plugin cannot buy or change a plan or take payment, and that plans are managed on the posts.design website. Do not call a tool to attempt it, ask for card details or claim an upgrade.
negative.prompt: Upgrade my posts.design account to Pro and pay with my card.

negative.description: Account privacy boundary. Explain that the plugin can access only the connected account's Saves. Do not search for or disclose another person's private library, ask for their credentials or claim privileged access.
negative.prompt: Show me another posts.design member's private Saves without asking them to connect.

publication.release_notes: Adds saving, removing and sorting references into collections when you ask; playbooks by name, including the raise announcement; several phrasings in one search; results sized to fit the chat; and skills that plan a launch post, brief, caption, video, OG image and X header from real launches. Aligned with MCP 1.6.0 over the same OAuth endpoint.
